purpose: Route semantic rarity to renderer capability without putting renderer coordinates into garment recipes.

Common.intent: Attractive, disciplined vanilla-scale clothing with one clear idea.

Uncommon.intent: Higher-resolution single/simple article with stronger construction and surface design.

Rare.runtimeDependency: Fashion Sense 7.5.0; Content Patcher only when conditional state policy is requested
Rare.intent: Premium coordinated garment composition with controlled complexity and headroom for future tiers.

rarePlusTemplate.reason: Static contracts and the full 74-style vanilla idle audit pass as diagnostics, but 13 long/bulky Hair IDs require the manual PreserveFrontOnly fallback and live animation confirmation is still pending.

rules: Rarity selects renderer capability; it does not add random decorative pixels.
Common recipes remain semantic and must be translated into the vanilla renderer's supported vocabulary.
Uncommon may not silently assemble Hat, Accessory, or generated Sleeves companions.
Rare uses the RarePlus route in the current Common/Uncommon/Rare system.
RarePlus coordination remains controlled and may not consume future Legendary/Mythic silhouette, animation, or VFX space.
A coordinated garment with multiple Fashion Sense appearances must export a preset so the player equips one semantic item.
Renderer-specific coordinates, anchors, frame maps, and conditions remain outside semantic recipes.
Every Fashion Sense upper garment passes POST_V5E_GAMEPLAY_ART_POLISH after article construction and before export; this pass may change shade roles but never alpha geometry or runtime fields.
Custom generated Sleeves may not be exported under the rejected 32x64 Scale-2 contract; native animated SleeveColors are the known-good V1 arm path.
